clock-elapsed.text: The clock will show time in session.

clock-wall.text: The clock will show the time of day.

help.text: Say begin to start, or customize the session by naming a vibe, a focus, or a length of time.

tour-done.text: That's the important stuff. Say begin when you're ready.

tour-exploration.text: Exploration is a conversation. Speak a sentence or two about a sensation or feeling you're experiencing, and I'll ask short questions to help you explore.

tour-felt-sense.text: Felt sense follows a six step process where you'll feel into your body's responses in order to investigate something that's on your mind, and get to the root of it.

tour-focus.text: A focus tells me where you plan to put your attention: the body, emotions, or parts of yourself. Or leave it blank.

tour-hello.text: Welcome to aloud, the meditation app that speaks and listens. Turn on the microphone and you can answer me out loud.

tour-noting.text: Noting is simple. Just name something you're noticing in a word or two, like warmth or relaxation. You can add sounds or virtual participants to keep the pace between turns.

tour-vibe.text: Vibes set the tone of the session. Playful, spacious, compassionate, or any mix you like.

tour-voice-control.text: You can configure a session by talking. For example, say 'set timer to twenty minutes', and I'll set a timer.

tour-voice-picked.text: Good. There are more voices in the voice picker whenever you like.

voice-intro-first.text: Hi, I'm Ethan. This is how I sound.

voice-intro-second.text: And I'm Ethan. Say which of us you'd like, or tap our name.

voice-intro-second.text: And I'm Harper. Say which of us you'd like, or tap our name.

help.text: 说“开始”就可以开始，也可以说出氛围、焦点或时长来定制这次冥想。

tour-done.text: 重要的就这些。想开始的时候，说“开始”就可以了。

tour-exploration.text: 探索是一场对话。用一两句话说说你此刻的身体感觉或情绪，我会用简短的问题陪你探索。

tour-felt-sense.text: 体会分六步：去感受身体的反应，借此探究心里的那件事，找到它的根源。

tour-focus.text: 焦点告诉我你打算把注意力放在哪里：身体、情绪，或内在的各个部分。也可以不选。

tour-hello.text: 欢迎来到 aloud，一款会说也会听的冥想应用。打开麦克风，你就可以直接开口回答我。

tour-noting.text: 标记很简单。只要用一两个词说出你正注意到的，比如温暖或放松。还可以加入音效或虚拟参与者，在你开口的间隙保持节奏。

tour-vibe.text: 氛围决定这次冥想的基调。轻松有玩心、开阔、慈悲，可以随意搭配。

tour-voice-control.text: 你可以用说话来设置冥想。比如说“计时二十分钟”，我就会设好计时。

tour-voice-picked.text: 好的。以后随时可以在声音选择里换别的声音。

voice-intro-first.text: 你好，我是 Serena。这是我的声音。

voice-intro-second.text: 我是 Serena。想听谁的声音？说出名字，或者点一下我们的名字。
